title: 第5章 暴揍二狗第6章 老父亲激动到流泪儿子的病终于好了
content_zh:
;;
李二狗想到此处，飞快的掏出手机看一眼。
情况和昨天踩点的一致，整座后山上都没有信号，电话打不出去。
这就好办了。
只要守住这个下山的分叉口，不让赵玉兰去报信就成。
李二狗有了主意毫不迟疑，迅速跑到岔路口蹲伏起来。
等候着赵玉兰下山。
不知不觉间。
他蹲在草丛中等了小半个小时赵玉兰也没下来。
心下一紧。
不对啊。
后山就这么点高，正常人下来二十分钟就完全足够。
如果是用跑的，顶多十来分钟。
难道......她没下来，而是去悬崖下找那死傻子去了？
李二狗转念一想。
嘿嘿。
如果是这样的话更好，还省了他再把赵玉兰扛上去伪造事故现场的力气。
他随即更改守株待兔的方案，迅速往悬崖下方摸过去。
等他拨开比人还高的荆棘从到达古墓处，映入眼帘的却是让他无比火大的一幕。
赵玉兰那个平日无比火爆的贞洁烈妇.

此刻正.............
“好啊！”
“寡妇在荒郊野外偷傻子，被我撞见了吧！”
李二狗忽然出现，吓得赵玉兰站立不稳，跌............
一刹那间........
赵玉兰被撞破好事，俏脸涨得通红。
可她现在没时间娇羞，眼下这种情况，李二狗很难不歹心复燃！
她急忙站起来拉下旗袍，捡起一块巴掌大石头护在李向东面前强装镇定道：
“李二狗，你杀人未遂，居然还敢回来。”
“告诉你，我已经叫人了，你现在跑路还来得及！”
李二狗听着她蹩脚的威胁，脑子一转，淫笑着晃动手里的手机。
“打电话，你给谁打电话？你打的出去吗？”
content_en:
;;
Li Ergou thought of this and quickly took out his cell phone to take a look.
The situation was consistent with what I visited yesterday. There was no signal on the entire back mountain and I couldn’t make calls.
This is easy to handle.
As long as we guard the fork going down the mountain and prevent Zhao Yulan from reporting the news.
Li Ergou had an idea and without hesitation, he quickly ran to the fork in the road and crouched down.
Waiting for Zhao Yulan to come down the mountain.
Unknowingly.
He squatted in the grass and waited for half an hour, but Zhao Yulan didn't come down.
My heart tightened.
That's not right.
The back mountain is only so high, and it takes twenty minutes for a normal person to get down there.
If you run, it will take about ten minutes at most.
Could it be that...she didn't come down, but went to look for that damn idiot under the cliff?
Li Ergou had a second thought.
hey-hey.
It would be better if this was the case, as it would save him the effort of carrying Zhao Yulan up to fake the accident scene.
He immediately changed his plan to wait and see, and quickly went to the bottom of the cliff.
When he pushed through the thorns taller than a man and reached the ancient tomb, what he saw was a scene that made him extremely angry.
Zhao Yulan, the chaste and fierce woman who is usually extremely hot.
Right now......................
"Okay!"
"The widow was stealing from a fool in the wilderness. I must have caught her!"
Li Ergou suddenly appeared, frightening Zhao Yulan to the point of losing her balance and falling...
In an instant..........
Zhao Yulan's pretty face turned red when her good deed was revealed.
But she doesn't have time to be shy now. In this situation, it's hard for Li Ergou not to rekindle his evil intentions!
She hurriedly stood up and pulled off her cheongsam, picked up a big stone and protected it in front of Li Xiangdong, pretending to be calm:
"Li Ergou, you attempted murder, but you still dare to come back."
"I'm telling you, I've already called someone, you still have time to run away now!"
Li Ergou listened to her lame threat, his mind changed, and he shook the mobile phone in his hand with a lewd smile.
"Call, who are you calling? Can you call out?"
